{{Quote|This station's ''hypermatter'' will soon be as hot as a star's core&mdash;and you with it!|[[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Hypermatters">{{TCWComicCite|6.40|Hypermatters}}</ref>}}
A '''hypermatter refinery''' operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] within [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it was [[Raid on the Republic hypermatter refinery|attacked]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] under the command of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]].
